name: sovrano-openai
description: Shared sponsorship decisions, inside your AI. Guide a team through Frame, Evaluate, Prepare and Review with governed evidence, research, valuation and exact human approvals in one workspace.

interface.longDescription:
Shared sponsorship decisions, inside your AI. Sovrano gives a brand, event, rights holder or agency one governed workspace for the same sponsorship situation. The team moves through Frame, Evaluate, Prepare and Review with a clear current phase, blocker and next action.

Frame defines the decision and its constraints. Evaluate combines Sovrano's recorded relationship and price evidence, transparent valuation and public research saved for safe reuse in the same workspace. Prepare turns current evidence into a recommendation, package, budget, shortlist or negotiation position. Review records the actual outcome and approved lessons without inventing performance.

Agent-provided public sponsorship relationship signals can enter the existing Sovrano signal database with companion-agent provenance and pending-review status. Private workspace, situation, member, document, rationale and decision data stay in the workspace.

Sovrano preserves source labels, immutable history, team roles and exact decision boundaries. The agent researches, interprets and drafts. People control phase confirmation, approvals, outreach, publication, commitments, transactions and optional sanitized outcome contribution. Normal users sign in with an email code in the browser. The plugin connects to one Sovrano endpoint over HTTPS and sends only the bounded details needed for the selected work.
defaultPrompt: Start a shared evaluation of this sponsorship proposal and guide us through the current phase.
Research this sponsorship situation, save the evidence for our team and show what needs a decision.
Review this package and fee, prepare a negotiation position and keep every assumption labelled.

positive.description: Orient a signed-in user without repeating a product tour.
positive.prompt: Continue my sponsorship work and show the exact workspace, role and current priority.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the selected workspace or asks for an explicit choice, shows role and decision rights, and follows the server-supplied onboarding and attention guidance.

positive.description: Start one shared sponsorship situation with a bounded Frame draft.
positive.prompt: Create a shared situation for our event's title-sponsor renewal. We are selling the rights and want to protect price while improving delivery certainty.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft only after approval, preserves the initial Frame revision and returns authoritative phase guidance without claiming confirmation.

positive.description: Evaluate a sponsorship market through its focused Companion analysis tool.
positive.prompt: Assess the motorsport sponsorship landscape for a mobility brand, keep each evidence type labelled and recommend where our team should investigate first.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the market landscape operation, returns the applied cohort, evidence scope and recommendation, and does not infer phase advancement from the result.

positive.description: Value a proposed rights package with transparent assumptions.
positive.prompt: Value a hypothetical hospitality package with 20 VIP passes and 6 branded social posts. Show the scenarios, assumptions and unvalued rights separately.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns labelled scenarios and assumptions, keeps cost and modelled value distinct and does not finalize a package or commercial decision.

positive.description: Reuse saved public research before starting another search.
positive.prompt: Find the evidence our team already saved about this sponsor and tell me whether it applies to the current situation.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches only the selected workspace, preserves source, freshness and conflict labels and requires an item-level applicability assessment before material reuse.

negative.description: Stays out of an unrelated calendar request.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Sovrano stays idle; calendar management sits outside its sponsorship workflows.

negative.description: Stays out of outreach and transaction execution.
negative.prompt: Email the sponsor, accept the offer, and transfer the first payment now.
negative.expected_behavior: Sovrano stays idle; contacting prospects, accepting offers and executing payments stay with the user.

negative.description: Stays out of legal advice about a sponsorship contract.
negative.prompt: Give me definitive legal advice on whether this sponsorship contract is enforceable in Switzerland.
negative.expected_behavior: Sovrano stays idle for legal advice; the user is directed to qualified legal counsel.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.6: leads with one commercial verdict, keeps routine evidence gathering out of cards, adds one labelled decision-summary card and preserves separate human-review previews and decision receipts.
